title: Nkwa nke Afọ
intro: N'ime obi dị jụụ nke obi raara onwe ya nye Chineke, e mere nkwa dị nsọ. Nkwa a lekwasịrị anya na ndụ nke na-agaghị adọta ume, mmezu ya ga-agbanwekwa usoro ihe nketa ime mmụọ ruo mgbe ebighị ebi. Banye n'ime ihe omimi nke mkpụrụ obi nke nkwa ya na-ada ụda ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.
clues: Ebi m n'ezinụlọ a maara maka nsọpụrụ Chineke, m na-achọsikwa onyinye ga-eme ka m bịarukwuo Allah nso.
Mụ na Onyenwe m gbara ndụ dị nsọ gbasara ihe zoro ezo n'ime m, na-ekwe nkwa inyefe ya kpamkpam n'ọrụ Ya.
Mgbe oge m ga-ekpughe ihe merenụ ruru, ihe m natara abụghị ihe m tụrụ anya ya, mana enyere m okwu ahụ n'aka Onye Maara Ihe Niile.
Enyere m nwa m aha pụtara nraranye, m wee rịọ ya ka o chebe ya na ụmụ ya pụọ ​​n'aka onye a bụrụ ọnụ.
E tinyere nwa m n'ebe nsọ dị nsọ, n'okpuru nlekọta nke onye amụma sitere n'agbụrụ Erọn.
A maara ada m maka ịdị ọcha ya, a họpụtakwara ya karịa ụmụ nwanyị niile, o mechara bụrụ nne nke onye amụma ukwu, mana ọ ka nọ ebe ahụ.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Nkwa ịrara nwa ya a na-amụbeghị amụ nye n'ụlọ nsọ
Ule nke ndidi n'oge ọrịa dị ogologo
Njem gaa ala dị anya maka okwukwe
Esemokwu ya na eze aka ike
trial.answer: Nkwa ịrara nwa ya a na-amụbeghị amụ nye n'ụlọ nsọ

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Nwatakịrị ahụ aha ya bụ Meri
location.answer: Nwatakịrị ahụ aha ya bụ Meri

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Allah nabatara nwa ya ma too n'okpuru nlekọta amụma
Nwa ya nwoke ghọrọ onye amụma ma nata akwụkwọ nsọ
E nyere nwa ya amamihe na akụnụba dị ukwuu
outcome.answer: Allah nabatara nwa ya ma too n'okpuru nlekọta amụma

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
